# v0.7.0 legacy API snapshot

This page is a historical migration reference for users upgrading from
`stax-xml@0.7.0`. It is not the current API documentation. Use the
[v1.0.0 documentation](/stax-xml/v1.0.0/) for new code.

The original v0.7.0 source and package metadata remain available at the
[v0.7.0 Git tag](https://github.com/Clickin/stax-xml/tree/v0.7.0).

## Main API names in v0.7.0

v0.7.0 exposed the older parser family, including `StaxXmlParser`,
`StaxXmlParserSync`, `StaxXmlCursorReader`, `StaxXmlWriter`, and
`StaxXmlWriterSync`. Those names are not the v1 public surface.

## v1 migration direction

- Use `EventReader`/`EventReaderSync` for materialized event iteration.
- Use `StreamReader`/`StreamReaderSync` for current-token streaming access.
- Use the v1 `Writer` and `WriterSync` APIs for output.
- Recheck converter and XPath imports against the v1 converter documentation;
  the old parser-specific helpers and cursor types were redesigned.
- Native addon, Wasm tokenizer, and backend-selection paths are not part of the
  v1 package contract.

The v0.7.0 snapshot is retained to explain the API transition; it should not
be treated as a supported compatibility layer.
